name: Baladio
description: A local music player desktop app.

paragraphs: In French, baladeur is a noun that means a personal stereo, portable music player, or walkman. Baladio is a combination of "baladeur" and "audio". Pronunciation: bah-LAH-dee-oh.
A self-hosted, privacy-first desktop music player with a glassmorphism UI, spatial 8D audio, and listening analytics.
Features · Getting Started · Screenshots · Keyboard Shortcuts · Project Structure · License
features: Local-First & Privacy-Focused - plays audio files directly from your machine. No mandatory accounts, no cloud streaming, no telemetry tracking.
Spatial 8D Audio - HRTF-based binaural panning using the Web Audio API. Smooth spatial rotation continues seamlessly in the background without timer throttling.
Studio Reverb & DSP Effects - convolution reverb with dual Room/Plate modes, Gaussian early reflections, pitch-shifted bass boost, and custom playback speeds (0.5× to 2.0×).
Listening Analytics - home dashboard tracking top songs, top artists, hottest playlists, daily play counts, artists explored, and day streaks.
Synced Lyrics - real-time synchronized lyrics fetched silently via LRCLIB with scrolling karaoke fullscreen mode, manual candidate matching, and custom .lrc/.txt file uploads.
